lastCompletedStory.title: On-demand record-golden harness + record:golden alias + patterns bullet

nextStoryContext: US-004 added scripts/record-golden.ts (on-demand refresh harness for the golden fixtures written by US-001/US-002/US-003) plus a `bun run record:golden` alias and a patterns.md bullet. It refreshes only the four fixtures that mirror artifacts a live `cam run` session writes to disk (worker-report.json, review-report.json, orch-handoff.json, handoff.json) via a plain file-copy when the live source exists on disk, skipping (never erroring) when it does not; it deliberately does NOT touch the hand-crafted edge-case fixtures (sentinel-*.txt, review-clean.txt, review-fixes-pending.txt, transcript-usage.jsonl), which stay hand-curated. Followed the scripts/test-in-container.ts precedent exactly: self-documented on-demand header, absent from GATES in scripts/check-all.ts and from .github/workflows/ci.yml, verified by direct grep after writing. scripts/**/*.ts was already a knip entry so no ignore entry was needed. Check prd.json for any remaining stories in the CAM-302 PRD before assuming more work is needed; if none remain (all non-operator stories passing), the next dispatch is review, not another implement story.
